correctness: probe kernels are never evaluated against the task oracle; the two expand arms carry a full element-wise coverage check against the CPU decode
coverage_method: Each expand producer writes the exact +-1 decode of every packed word into scratch[K, N]. After a timed run the probe reads the whole scratch back and requires element-wise equality with the CPU decode of the same words (uint16 half bits for fp16/packed16, float32 for fp32). The packed and all three shared GEMM arms receive the same bits and x=1 and must produce identical y.
